command.name: wtnew
command.provenance: wtnew --help ('Create a fresh git worktree for manual (non-drain) work'), packages/wtnew/wtnew/wtnew.sh show_help

provenance.source: wtnew --help, first line: "wtnew: Create a fresh git worktree for manual (non-drain) work"; packages/wtnew/wtnew/wtnew.sh show_help and the `git worktree add` call at the end of the script

stdin.source: wtnew --help: "Usage: wtnew <bead-or-name> [OPTIONS]"; the script (wtnew.sh) never reads stdin

stdout.source: wtnew --help: "prints the same integration-facts JSON block `integrate-branch-support` prints" (a metadata block; git worktree add chatter is routed to stderr)

unknownFlag.source: wtnew.sh option parser: `-*) die "unknown option: $1"`; --help lists exactly --base, --branch, -h/--help, -v/--version

citation.source: wtnew --help: "--base <ref>  Base ref to branch from. Default: this repo's resolved primary branch" a ref name, inert
wtnew --help: "--branch <name>  Branch name. Default: <bead-or-name>, PLAIN" a branch name, inert
wtnew --help, Arguments: "<bead-or-name>  Directory name under .worktrees/, and (unless --branch is given) the new branch name too ... must not contain '/'" the one positional, an inert name

wtnew.sh: `wt="$root/.worktrees/$NAME"` then `git -C "$root" worktree add "$wt" -b "$branch" "$base"`: creates one directory under the repo's .worktrees (the same PathCreate git worktree add's leading positional gets)
wtnew.sh: reads the repo (`git rev-parse`, `canonical_root`, `pg-hooks status --porcelain`) and runs the bare, read-only `integrate-branch-support` from inside the new worktree
